raw.thesis: narma addresses the critical challenge AI-first enterprises face in demonstrating and scaling AI automation. Its core innovation lies in a three-layered architecture: observing work patterns, intelligent detection of intent and value, and automated AI agent deployment. It targets AI-first companies that struggle to accurately measure AI ROI and manage operational drift. The vision is to provide a comprehensive system for continuous AI lift by identifying high-ROI opportunities and automating agent creation. narma positions itself as a complementary solution that enhances existing AI investments by providing visibility, validation, and automated deployment capabilities.
raw.one_liner: narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies to observe, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale.
raw.what_makes_this_different: narma's innovation lies in its "Enterprise Agentic Brain" approach, which combines observation, intelligence, and auto-generation of AI agents to achieve continuous AI lift. Instead of creating new foundation models, it focuses on analyzing the "Work Graph" to pinpoint where AI can provide the most value.

raw.product_description: narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" with a three-layered architecture. Layer 1 (Observe) uses lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns, application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation. Layer 2 (Intelligence Layer) acts as a "Brain" to detect employee intent, business value of tasks, and "drift" from intended work flows. Layer 3 (Execution Layer) is an "Agent Factory" that generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for validated high-ROI opportunities, incorporating built-in approval gates. The system leverages existing foundation models and focuses on a "Work Graph" to identify areas for AI intervention and assistance mid-flow. The overarching vision is a single system for observing work, deciding AI actions, and continuously building agents for "Continuous AI lift."
